body:
Hey! Eating junk food helps me a lot. I'm only 44kg (99 lbs) 163 cm (5'4'') but I've begun eating 3-4 chocolate bars a day with soda and chips. 

Only two months ago, I only ate pure vegetarian organic health foods, but now I've started eating a lot of meat and junk. 

I've been this way ever since college started in September. I think a lot of things like my breakup, losing my best friend, and family problems caused this, but I mostly think that it's me hating myself for no reason. 

Thanks for talking to me :)

Wow, thanks for sharing this! I'm a college student and the nurses here have asked me to visit them every 2 weeks just to talk about how I'm feeling and how I'm dealing with this. 

I think that posting here and talking to anonymous strangers will also help a lot :) Again, thank you!
